scope_items.item: The browser reads chart, card and labels data from queryapi at getProjectScopedBase(projectId) + /apis/o11y.miloapis.com/v1alpha1/metrics/api/v1/..., through /api/proxy
query and query_range go as form-encoded POSTs
Delete the /api/prometheus server route and its registration
The metrics hooks take a required projectId and every caller passes it
The UI shows clear messages for queryapi's 422 (response too large) and 503 (timeout)
A user without metrics permissions sees the existing no-permission state
Project editor and owner roles grant metrics.query, metrics.getLabels, metrics/v1.get and metrics/v1.create

scope_items.item: Tests for the o11y-metrics service and the request path in the hook
Remove PROMETHEUS_URL from env.server.ts, types.ts, .env.example and config/base/deployment.yaml
Responses keep the Prometheus envelope, so formatter.ts, the charts and the existing queries stay as they are

scope_creep.description: Removed the 'connection' and 'buildinfo' members from the client-side request type, which #1730 lists; the server-side code for them is untouched

edge_cases.description: A malformed PromQL query (queryapi 400 bad_data) maps to a query error: no retries, query message shown
A queryapi 503/504 timeout is not retried, so the expensive query isn't rerun
Cached results could cross projects when two projects issue the same query
Refresh control invalidates by the 'prometheus-api' prefix after projectId is appended to keys
Label names with reserved characters in the label-values path
